Based on ["Emotion Concepts and their Function in a Large Language Model"](https://transformer-circuits.pub/2026/emotions) paper.

[Read the notebook on Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/code/nikolazhuk/interp-emotions-01)

### Top 20 features: joy vs neutral

SAE features (layer 20) ranked by mean activation on joy prompts minus neutral prompts. Click a feature id to open it on Neuronpedia.

{{< embed copy_interp-emotions-01_with_output_cells.ipynb#joy-features-neuronpedia-table >}}

### Top joy feature on joy prompts

Each token is coloured by how strongly the top joy feature fires on it. Joy and neutral prompts share one colour scale (0 – 69.5), so their colours are directly comparable.

{{< embed copy_interp-emotions-01_with_output_cells.ipynb#joy-prompts-top-feature >}}
